   139	  }
   140	  function _utf8Bytes(s) {
   141	    try {
   142	      if (typeof s !== 'string') return 0;
   143	      if (_CAPTURED_TEXT_ENCODER !== null) return new _CAPTURED_TEXT_ENCODER().encode(s).length;
   144	      return (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') ? Buffer.byteLength(s, 'utf8') : s.length * 4;
   145	    } catch (e) { return Infinity; }
   146	  }

   149	  // The captures above MUST themselves still resolve as expected at call time. If the host
   150	  // mutates Object.isFrozen between module load and the first classifyOutcome call, the
   151	  // captured reference remains intact (we hold the function value), but defence-in-depth
   152	  // we re-verify the contract surfaces are frozen at call entry.
   153	  var _CONTRACTS_FROZEN_AT_LOAD = (function () {
   154	    try {
   155	      return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS_FROZEN(EXP) === true
   156	          && _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS_FROZEN(OUT) === true
   157	          && _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS_FROZEN(CV) === true
   158	          && _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS_FROZEN(RC_E) === true;
   159	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   160	  })();

   163	    if (!_CONTRACTS_FROZEN_AT_LOAD) return false;
   164	    if (typeof EXP.validateExperimentShape !== 'function') return false;
   165	    if (typeof OUT.validateOutcomeShape !== 'function') return false;
   166	    if (typeof CV.validateControlVariableShape !== 'function') return false;
   167	    if (typeof RC_E.buildBlockedResult !== 'function') return false;
   168	    return true;

   175	      explanationKeys: _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(['r3_0e.reason.internal_contract_violation']),
   176	      detail: typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : 'intrinsic tampering detected',
   177	      result: null,
   178	    });
   179	  }

   231	  var ID_GRAMMAR_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/;

   233	  // Codex E3-R1-02 closure: strict i18n-key grammar — dotted tokens of [a-z0-9_], 2..6
   234	  // segments, total length bounded. First segment must start with [a-z]; subsequent
   235	  // segments may start with [a-z0-9] (the project convention uses tokens like "0e" / "0d"
   236	  // for R3.0E / R3.0D namespacing, e.g. `r3.0e.driver.feedback.balance_improved`).
   237	  // Rejects spaces, slashes, blame phrasing, causal wording, capital letters, and any
   238	  // character outside the closed alphabet so a hostile caller cannot launder
   239	  // driver-blame / causation text / path traversal through `driverFeedback`.

   241	  var I18N_KEY_MAX_LEN = 128;

   246	  // After successful classifyOutcome → registered. The exported verifyAuthoritativeOutcome
   247	  // checks identity (WeakSet) + shape (deep-frozen + required fields). Clones and JSON
   248	  // round-trips lose identity → verifier returns false.
   249	  var _authoritativeOutcomes = new _WeakSetCtor();
   250	  function _registerAuthoritativeOutcome(envelope) {
   251	    _wsAdd(_authoritativeOutcomes, envelope);

   253	  function verifyAuthoritativeOutcome(candidate) {
   254	    try {
   255	      if (candidate === null || typeof candidate !== 'object') return false;
   256	      if (!_wsHas(_authoritativeOutcomes, candidate)) return false;
   257	      if (_CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS_FROZEN(candidate) !== true) return false;
   258	      if (candidate.schemaVersion !== OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION) return false;
   259	      if (typeof candidate.outcomeId !== 'string') return false;
   260	      if (typeof candidate.experimentId !== 'string') return false;
   261	      if (typeof candidate['class'] !== 'string') return false;
   262	      if (!_isArraySafe(candidate.confounders)) return false;
   263	      if (!_isArraySafe(candidate.limitations)) return false;
   264	      return true;
   265	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   266	  }

   268	  // ---------- Structural helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
   269	  function _isOriginalPlainObject(v) {
   270	    try {
   271	      if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object' || _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   272	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   273	      return p === Object.prototype || p === null;
   274	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   275	  }
   276	  function _isPlainArray(v) {
   277	    try {
   278	      if (!_CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   279	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   280	      return p === Array.prototype;
   281	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   282	  }
   283	  function _hasSymbolOwnKey(o) {
   284	    try {
   285	      var syms = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_SYMS(o);
   286	      return _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(syms) && syms.length > 0;
   287	    } catch (e) { return true; }
   288	  }
   289	  function _nonEmptyStr(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0; }
   290	  function _isFiniteNumber(v) {
   291	    return typeof v === 'number' && _CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_FINITE(v) === true;
   292	  }
   293	  function _isBool(v) { return v === true || v === false; }
   294	  function _idGrammarOk(s) {
   295	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   296	    if (ID_FORBIDDEN_RE.test(s)) return false;
   297	    if (!ID_GRAMMAR_RE.test(s)) return false;
   298	    return true;
   299	  }
   300	  // Codex E3-R1-02 closure: strict i18n-key grammar enforcement. driverFeedback (and any
   301	  // future i18n-keyed surface in the outcome) MUST pass this gate before being copied to
   302	  // the outcome envelope.
   303	  function _i18nKeyOk(s) {
   304	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   305	    if (s.length > I18N_KEY_MAX_LEN) return false;
   306	    if (!I18N_KEY_RE.test(s)) return false;
   307	    return true;
   308	  }
   309	  // Codex E3-R1-01 / E3-R5-02 closure: null-prototype membership set backed by a
   310	  // closure-local captured Array (not an object map). add() uses captured
   311	  // Array.prototype.push via captured Reflect.apply; has() uses captured indexOf.
   312	  // This eliminates the entire `defineProperty` attack surface from the set abstraction
   313	  // (a hostile pre-load defineProperty cannot inject phantom keys because we never
   314	  // call defineProperty for membership tracking). The set is shape-private: it is a
   315	  // plain array of string keys, never exposed beyond the classifier closure.
   316	  function _newCapturedNullSet() {
   317	    return [];
   318	  }
   319	  function _capturedSetHas(setObj, key) {
   320	    if (!_isPlainArray(setObj)) return false;
   321	    return _arrIndexOf(setObj, key) !== -1;
   322	  }
   323	  function _capturedSetAdd(setObj, key) {
   324	    if (!_isPlainArray(setObj)) return false;
   325	    if (_arrIndexOf(setObj, key) !== -1) return true;
   326	    return _arrPush(setObj, key);
   327	  }
   328	
   329	  // Deep freeze using captured Object.freeze + captured getOwnPropertyNames.
   330	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   331	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   332	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   333	    var keys;
   334	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   335	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   336	      var k = keys[i];
   337	      var child;
   338	      try { child = v[k]; } catch (eGet) { continue; }
   339	      _deepFreeze(child);
   340	    }
   341	    return v;
   342	  }
   343	
   344	  // ---------- Input descriptor snapshot --------------------------------------------------------
   345	  // Mirrors D5 snapshotInputDescriptors: walks own descriptors (NOT [[Get]]) so a Proxy with
   346	  // hostile getters does NOT fire on first read. Symbol / non-enumerable / accessor / unknown
   347	  // own key → reject before any further inspection.
   348	  function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {
   349	    opts = opts || {};
   350	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) {
   351	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   352	    }
   353	    if (opts.requireFrozen && _isFrozenSafe(o) !== true) {
   354	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not frozen' };
   355	    }
   356	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) {
   357	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   358	    }
   359	    var names;
   360	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); } catch (e) {
   361	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor read failed' };
   362	    }
   363	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   364	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   365	      var k = names[i];
   366	      // Reject unknown own key — caller cannot smuggle `class`, `outcomeId`, `confounders`,
   367	      // etc. into the input wrapper.
   368	      if (_arrIndexOf(allowedKeys, k) === -1) {
   369	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown own key ' + k };
   370	      }
   371	      var d;
   372	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); } catch (e) {
   373	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor inaccessible' };
   374	      }
   375	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) {
   376	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable key ' + k };
   377	      }
   378	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   379	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor key ' + k };
   380	      }
   381	      snap[k] = d.value;
   382	    }
   383	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   384	  }
   385	
   386	  // Codex E3-R1-03 closure: dense-array enforcement. Reject sparse arrays (any index in
   387	  // 0..length-1 missing an enumerable data descriptor → hole) AND reject any own key
   388	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   389	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   390	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   391	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   392	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   393	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {
   394	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not array' };
   395	    }
   396	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(a)) {
   397	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key on array' };
   398	    }
   399	    var aLen;
   400	    try { aLen = a.length; } catch (e) {
   401	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array length inaccessible' };
   402	    }
   403	    if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(aLen) || aLen < 0 || aLen > ARRAY_CAP) {
   404	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], detail: 'array len ' + aLen };
   405	    }
   406	    // First sweep: enumerate own keys and reject ANY name other than 'length' or a
   407	    // canonical numeric index in [0, aLen). Reject Symbol keys (already above), reject
   408	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   409	    var names;
   410	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(a); } catch (e) {
   411	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array desc inaccessible' };
   412	    }
   413	    for (var ni = 0; ni < names.length; ni++) {
   414	      var nm = names[ni];
   415	      if (nm === 'length') continue;
   416	      if (!ARRAY_INDEX_RE.test(nm)) {
   417	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'non-index own key on array: ' + nm };
   418	      }
   419	      var idxN = +nm;
   420	      if (idxN < 0 || idxN >= aLen) {
   421	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array index out of [0,length): ' + nm };
   422	      }
   423	      var dn;
   424	      try { dn = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, nm); } catch (e) {
   425	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail' };
   426	      }
   427	      if (!dn || dn.enumerable !== true) {
   428	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + nm };
   429	      }
   430	      if (typeof dn.get === 'function' || typeof dn.set === 'function') {
   431	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };
   432	      }
   433	    }
   434	    // Second sweep: walk by index 0..aLen-1. Every index MUST have an OWN enumerable
   435	    // data descriptor (no holes, no prototype-inherited values).
   436	    var snap = [];
   437	    for (var i = 0; i < aLen; i++) {
   438	      var key = '' + i;
   439	      var d;
   440	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, key); } catch (e) {
   441	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail at ' + i };
   442	      }
   443	      if (!d) {
   444	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'sparse array hole at index ' + i };
   445	      }
   446	      if (d.enumerable !== true) {
   447	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + i };
   448	      }
   449	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   450	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + i };
   451	      }
   452	      _arrPush(snap, d.value);
   453	    }
   454	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   455	  }
   456	
   457	  function _snapshotOpts(optsIn) {
   458	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   459	    if (optsIn === undefined || optsIn === null) return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   460	    var r = _snapshotPlainShape(optsIn, OPTS_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   461	    if (r.valid !== true) return r;
   462	    // Type-check each opt.
   463	    if (r.snapshot.clock !== undefined && r.snapshot.clock !== null && typeof r.snapshot.clock !== 'function') {
   464	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.clock not function' };
   465	    }
   466	    if (r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== null
   467	        && typeof r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== 'number') {
   468	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.referenceNowMs not number' };
   469	    }
   470	    if (r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== null
   471	        && (typeof r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(r.snapshot.maxAgeMs) || r.snapshot.maxAgeMs < 0)) {
   472	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.maxAgeMs invalid' };
   473	    }
   474	    return { valid: true, snapshot: r.snapshot };
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generator -------------------------------------------------------
   478	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   479	  function _hash32(s) {
   480	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   481	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   482	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   483	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   484	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   485	    }
   486	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   487	  }
   488	  function _fnv2(s) {
   489	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   490	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   491	  }
   492	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   493	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);
   494	  }
   495	
   496	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   497	  /**
   498	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   499	   *
   500	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   501	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   502	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   503	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   504	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   505	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   506	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   507	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   508	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   509	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   510	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   511	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   512	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   513	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   514	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   515	   *   14. compose outcome
   516	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   517	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   518	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   519	   */
   520	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {
   521	    try {
   522	      // ---- Step 0: intrinsic integrity ----------------------------------------------------
   523	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   524	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected at entry');
   525	      }
   526	
   527	      // ---- Step 1: input wrapper descriptor snapshot -------------------------------------
   528	      var inSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputIn, INPUT_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, { requireFrozen: false });
   529	      if (inSnapR.valid !== true) {
   530	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(inSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: inSnapR.detail });
   531	      }
   532	      var inputSnap = inSnapR.snapshot;
   533	
   534	      // ---- Step 2: experiment shape validation -------------------------------------------
   535	      // The Experiment must be deep-frozen (immutability) AND pass the E1 contract.
   536	      if (!_isFrozenSafe(inputSnap.experiment)) {
   537	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment not deep-frozen' });
   538	      }
   539	      var expCheck = EXP.validateExperimentShape(inputSnap.experiment);
   540	      if (expCheck.valid !== true) {
   541	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   542	          expCheck.reasonCodes ? _arrSlice(expCheck.reasonCodes) : [CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID],
   543	          { detail: 'experiment shape invalid' }
   544	        );
   545	      }
   546	      var experiment = inputSnap.experiment;
   547	
   548	      // ---- Step 3: appliedChange snapshot + shape ----------------------------------------
   549	      var acSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.appliedChange, APPLIED_CHANGE_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   550	      if (acSnapR.valid !== true) {
   551	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(acSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'appliedChange: ' + acSnapR.detail });
   552	      }
   553	      var appliedChange = acSnapR.snapshot;
   554	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.changeId)) {
   555	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.changeId invalid' });
   556	      }
   557	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.sourceExperimentId)) {
   558	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId invalid' });
   559	      }
   560	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(appliedChange.appliedAt) || _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt) === null) {
   561	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.appliedAt invalid' });
   562	      }
   563	
   564	      // ---- Step 4: followUp snapshot + shape ---------------------------------------------
   565	      var fuSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.followUp, FOLLOWUP_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   566	      if (fuSnapR.valid !== true) {
   567	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(fuSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'followUp: ' + fuSnapR.detail });
   568	      }
   569	      var followUp = fuSnapR.snapshot;
   570	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.followUpCaseId)) {
   571	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId invalid' });
   572	      }
   573	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentCaseId)) {
   574	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING], { detail: 'followUp.parentCaseId invalid' });
   575	      }
   576	      if (followUp.parentCaseId === followUp.followUpCaseId) {
   577	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'follow-up case is self-link' });
   578	      }
   579	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.sessionId)) {
   580	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.sessionId invalid' });
   581	      }
   582	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentSessionId)) {
   583	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.parentSessionId invalid' });
   584	      }
   585	      if (!_isBool(followUp.hasExplicitReference)) {
   586	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.hasExplicitReference not bool' });
   587	      }
   588	      if (!_isFiniteNumber(followUp.comparabilityScore) || followUp.comparabilityScore < 0 || followUp.comparabilityScore > 1) {
   589	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT], { detail: 'followUp.comparabilityScore out of [0,1]' });
   590	      }
   591	
   592	      // ---- Step 5: observation snapshot + shape ------------------------------------------
   593	      var obsSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.observation, OBSERVATION_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   594	      if (obsSnapR.valid !== true) {
   595	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(obsSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'observation: ' + obsSnapR.detail });
   596	      }
   597	      var observation = obsSnapR.snapshot;
   598	      // observedDirection: enum OR null
   599	      if (observation.observedDirection !== null && _arrIndexOf(DIRECTION_ALLOWED, observation.observedDirection) === -1) {
   600	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedDirection invalid' });
   601	      }
   602	      // observedMagnitude: finite OR null
   603	      if (observation.observedMagnitude !== null && !_isFiniteNumber(observation.observedMagnitude)) {
   604	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedMagnitude invalid' });
   605	      }
   606	      // driverFeedback: STRICT i18n key (dotted lower_snake_case, 2..6 segments, ≤128 chars)
   607	      // OR null. Codex E3-R1-02 closure: a non-empty-string check alone permits free-text
   608	      // blame / causation / paths to be laundered into the outcome envelope. The strict
   609	      // grammar rejects spaces, slashes, capital letters, and any character outside
   610	      // [a-z0-9._], blocking blame phrasing ("driver error because…") and path leakage
   611	      // ("/Users/…", "..\\etc\\…") at the contract boundary.
   612	      if (observation.driverFeedback !== null && !_i18nKeyOk(observation.driverFeedback)) {
   613	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID], { detail: 'driverFeedback not a strict i18n key' });
   614	      }
   615	      // dataQualityIssues / sideEffects / contradictingEvidenceIds / supportingEvidenceIds — bounded plain arrays.
   616	      var dqiR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.dataQualityIssues, CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
   617	      if (dqiR.valid !== true) {
   618	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(dqiR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'dataQualityIssues: ' + dqiR.detail });
   619	      }
   620	      var dataQualityIssues = dqiR.snapshot;
   621	      for (var qi = 0; qi < dataQualityIssues.length; qi++) {
   622	        if (!_nonEmptyStr(dataQualityIssues[qi])) {
   623	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID], { detail: 'dataQualityIssues[' + qi + '] not non-empty string' });
   624	        }
   625	      }
   626	      var seR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.sideEffects, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   627	      if (seR.valid !== true) {
   628	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(seR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'sideEffects: ' + seR.detail });
   629	      }
   630	      var sideEffects = seR.snapshot;
   631	      // Each side-effect must be a plain { i18nKey, params } object.
   632	      // Codex E3-R2-01 closure: i18nKey MUST pass the strict i18n grammar — same gate as
   633	      // driverFeedback — so free-text / blame / causation / path laundering through the
   634	      // side-effect surface is impossible.
   635	      // Codex E3-R2-02 closure: params is restricted to a CLOSED primitive allowlist
   636	      // (null OR plain object whose every value is a finite number / boolean / null).
   637	      // String values are FORBIDDEN to eliminate any free-text laundering vector. i18n
   638	      // substitution numerics (thresholds, magnitudes) remain expressible.
   639	      var SE_KEYS_FROZEN = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(['i18nKey', 'params']);
   640	      var rebuiltSideEffects = [];
   641	      for (var si = 0; si < sideEffects.length; si++) {
   642	        var se = sideEffects[si];
   643	        if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(se)) {
   644	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '] not plain' });
   645	        }
   646	        var seKeysR = _snapshotPlainShape(se, SE_KEYS_FROZEN, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   647	        if (seKeysR.valid !== true) {
   648	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(seKeysR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + ']: ' + seKeysR.detail });
   649	        }
   650	        var seK = seKeysR.snapshot.i18nKey;
   651	        var seP = seKeysR.snapshot.params;
   652	        if (!_i18nKeyOk(seK)) {
   653	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].i18nKey not strict i18n key' });
   654	        }
   655	        // Codex E3-R3-02 closure: rebuild params into a fresh plain object from validated
   656	        // descriptors so the outcome envelope does NOT retain a reference to the caller's
   657	        // original params object (a hostile caller could otherwise mutate it before the
   658	        // freeze sweep completes, or rely on identity to back-channel state). The new
   659	        // object is a `{}` plain-object (so it round-trips through E1 outcome shape
   660	        // validation which requires plain prototypes), populated only with the
   661	        // validated allowlist values.
   662	        var rebuiltParams = null;
   663	        if (seP !== null && seP !== undefined) {
   664	          if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(seP)) {
   665	            return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params not plain' });
   666	          }
   667	          if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(seP)) {
   668	            return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params has Symbol key' });
   669	          }
   670	          var pNames;
   671	          try { pNames = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(seP); }
   672	          catch (eDesc) { return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params desc fail' }); }
   673	          if (pNames.length > 16) {
   674	            return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params keys exceed cap' });
   675	          }
   676	          rebuiltParams = {};
   677	          for (var pi = 0; pi < pNames.length; pi++) {
   678	            var pk = pNames[pi];
   679	            // Codex E3-R2-02 closure: param KEY must itself be a sober identifier
   680	            // (lower_snake_case, ≤32 chars). No spaces / paths / capitals.
   681	            if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$/.test(pk)) {
   682	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params key not sober: ' + pk });
   683	            }
   684	            var pd;
   685	            try { pd = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(seP, pk); }
   686	            catch (eDesc2) { return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params desc fail at ' + pk }); }
   687	            if (!pd || pd.enumerable !== true) {
   688	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params non-enum key ' + pk });
   689	            }
   690	            if (typeof pd.get === 'function' || typeof pd.set === 'function') {
   691	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params accessor at ' + pk });
   692	            }
   693	            var pv = pd.value;
   694	            // CLOSED primitive allowlist — number (finite) / boolean / null. NO strings,
   695	            // NO objects, NO arrays. String values would be the laundering vector.
   696	            if (pv === null) {
   697	              // pass — plain assignment below
   698	            } else if (typeof pv === 'boolean') {
   699	              // pass
   700	            } else if (typeof pv === 'number') {
   701	              if (!_isFiniteNumber(pv)) {
   702	                return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params[' + pk + '] not finite number' });
   703	              }
   704	            } else {
   705	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params[' + pk + '] not in primitive allowlist (number/boolean/null)' });
   706	            }
   707	            // Define as own enumerable data property — no inheritance, no accessor.
   708	            // Codex E3-R4-01 closure: a host that poisoned Object.defineProperty BEFORE
   709	            // the classifier module loaded would have its replacement captured by
   710	            // _CAPTURED_OBJECT_DEFINE_PROPERTY, and the post-validation define call could
   711	            // store an arbitrary value (e.g. a path string) regardless of what we
   712	            // validated above. Defence: re-read the descriptor after define and require
   713	            //   (a) a data descriptor (no getter/setter installed by the poisoner),
   714	            //   (b) enumerable === true,
   715	            //   (c) Object.is(d.value, pv) — exact reference / value identity.
   716	            // Any mismatch → fail-closed BLOCK with no partial outcome.
   717	            try {
   718	              _CAPTURED_OBJECT_DEFINE_PROPERTY(rebuiltParams, pk, {
   719	                value: pv, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true,
   720	              });
   721	            } catch (eDef) {
   722	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params rebuild failed at ' + pk });
   723	            }
   724	            var dCheck;
   725	            try { dCheck = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(rebuiltParams, pk); }
   726	            catch (eRecheck) { return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params descriptor re-read failed' }); }
   727	            if (!dCheck || dCheck.enumerable !== true) {
   728	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params post-define non-enum at ' + pk });
   729	            }
   730	            if (typeof dCheck.get === 'function' || typeof dCheck.set === 'function') {
   731	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params post-define accessor at ' + pk });
   732	            }
   733	            if (!_exactlyEqual(dCheck.value, pv)) {
   734	              return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '].params post-define value mismatch at ' + pk + ' (intrinsic tampering suspected)' });
   735	            }
   736	          }
   737	        }
   738	        // Rebuild a clean side-effect record so the outcome envelope carries only the
   739	        // validated (deep-copied) structure — caller's original reference is dropped.
   740	        _arrPush(rebuiltSideEffects, { i18nKey: seK, params: rebuiltParams });
   741	      }
   742	      sideEffects = rebuiltSideEffects;
   743	      var contraR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.contradictingEvidenceIds, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   744	      if (contraR.valid !== true) {
   745	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(contraR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'contradictingEvidenceIds: ' + contraR.detail });
   746	      }
   747	      var contradictingEvidenceIds = contraR.snapshot;
   748	      for (var ci = 0; ci < contradictingEvidenceIds.length; ci++) {
   749	        if (!_idGrammarOk(contradictingEvidenceIds[ci])) {
   750	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'contradictingEvidenceIds[' + ci + '] invalid id' });
   751	        }
   752	      }
   753	      var supR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.supportingEvidenceIds, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   754	      if (supR.valid !== true) {
   755	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(supR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'supportingEvidenceIds: ' + supR.detail });
   756	      }
   757	      var supportingEvidenceIds = supR.snapshot;
   758	      for (var sii = 0; sii < supportingEvidenceIds.length; sii++) {
   759	        if (!_idGrammarOk(supportingEvidenceIds[sii])) {
   760	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'supportingEvidenceIds[' + sii + '] invalid id' });
   761	        }
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      // ---- Step 6: controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 -----------------
   765	      var cvObsR = _snapshotArrayShape(inputSnap.controlVariableObservations, CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID);
   766	      if (cvObsR.valid !== true) {
   767	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(cvObsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'controlVariableObservations: ' + cvObsR.detail });
   768	      }
   769	      var controlVariableObservations = cvObsR.snapshot;
   770	      // E1 contract per element. The CV contract permits observedValue + withinRange filled.
   771	      // Codex E3-R1-01 closure: observed-CV membership is tracked via a captured null-proto
   772	      // set with descriptor-based membership; an ambient Object.create rebind cannot
   773	      // synthesize membership entries because we use the captured Object.create + the
   774	      // captured Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor for has-checks.
   775	      var observedCvSet = _newCapturedNullSet();
   776	      for (var cvi = 0; cvi < controlVariableObservations.length; cvi++) {
   777	        var cvObs = controlVariableObservations[cvi];
   778	        var cvCheck = CV.validateControlVariableShape(cvObs);
   779	        if (cvCheck.valid !== true) {
   780	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   781	            cvCheck.reasonCodes ? _arrSlice(cvCheck.reasonCodes) : [CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID],
   782	            { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '] shape invalid' }
   783	          );
   784	        }
   785	        // E3 additionally requires observedValue + withinRange to be filled (non-null) — the
   786	        // E1 contract permits null for shape-only validation; E3 algorithm demands the
   787	        // observation be present so the integrity check can run.
   788	        if (cvObs.observedValue === null) {
   789	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING], { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '].observedValue null' });
   790	        }
   791	        if (cvObs.withinRange === null) {
   792	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING], { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '].withinRange null' });
   793	        }
   794	        if (_capturedSetHas(observedCvSet, cvObs.name)) {
   795	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID], { detail: 'duplicate control variable name: ' + cvObs.name });
   796	        }
   797	        _capturedSetAdd(observedCvSet, cvObs.name);
   798	      }
   799	
   800	      // ---- Step 7: opts snapshot ----------------------------------------------------------
   801	      var optsR = _snapshotOpts(optsIn);
   802	      if (optsR.valid !== true) {
   803	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(optsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'opts: ' + optsR.detail });
   804	      }
   805	      var optsSnap = optsR.snapshot;
   806	
   807	      // ---- Step 8: identity binding -------------------------------------------------------
   808	      if (experiment.status !== 'applied') {
   809	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_STATUS_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment.status must be applied to classify, got ' + experiment.status });
   810	      }
   811	      if (experiment.outcome !== null) {
   812	        // Defence-in-depth: E1 contract already enforces outcome=null for status=applied,
   813	        // but caller-supplied final classification is forbidden, so the classifier rejects
   814	        // any pre-filled outcome explicitly here too.
   815	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'caller-supplied experiment.outcome forbidden at classification' });
   816	      }
   817	      if (appliedChange.sourceExperimentId !== experiment.experimentId) {
   818	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId !== experiment.experimentId' });
   819	      }
   820	      // Codex E3-R3-01 closure: experiment.followUpCaseIds MUST pass the dense-array
   821	      // snapshot (E1's nested-descriptor audit does not catch sparse arrays — sparse
   822	      // [] enumerates only 'length' and slips through). Every id must pass the strict
   823	      // ID grammar. The provided followUp.followUpCaseId MUST be a member of the
   824	      // experiment's declared follow-up case ids — otherwise a caller could submit a
   825	      // followUp object pointing at an arbitrary case while the experiment's actual
   826	      // follow-up linkage was empty (or sparse) and the classifier would still produce
   827	      // a confirmed outcome despite the linkage break.
   828	      var followUpIdsR = _snapshotArrayShape(experiment.followUpCaseIds || [], CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID);
   829	      if (followUpIdsR.valid !== true) {
   830	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(followUpIdsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'experiment.followUpCaseIds: ' + followUpIdsR.detail });
   831	      }
   832	      var declaredFollowUpIds = followUpIdsR.snapshot;
   833	      var followUpDeclared = false;
   834	      for (var fui = 0; fui < declaredFollowUpIds.length; fui++) {
   835	        if (!_idGrammarOk(declaredFollowUpIds[fui])) {
   836	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment.followUpCaseIds[' + fui + '] invalid id' });
   837	        }
   838	        if (declaredFollowUpIds[fui] === followUp.followUpCaseId) followUpDeclared = true;
   839	      }
   840	      if (!followUpDeclared) {
   841	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId not declared in experiment.followUpCaseIds' });
   842	      }
   843	      // parentCaseId binding — followUp's parent MUST be the experiment's source case. If
   844	      // parentCaseId mismatches, treat as invalid_comparison (cross-case forbidden).
   845	      var crossCase = (followUp.parentCaseId !== experiment.sourceCaseId);
   846	      var crossSession = (followUp.sessionId !== followUp.parentSessionId);
   847	      var noExplicitReference = (followUp.hasExplicitReference !== true);
   848	      var lowComparability = (followUp.comparabilityScore < MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON);
   849	
   850	      // ---- Step 9: resolve freshness reference (clock AT MOST ONCE, post-authority) ------
   851	      var refNowMs = null;
   852	      var resolvedClockIso = null;
   853	      if (typeof optsSnap.referenceNowMs === 'number' && _CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(optsSnap.referenceNowMs) && optsSnap.referenceNowMs >= 0) {
   854	        refNowMs = optsSnap.referenceNowMs;
   855	      } else if (typeof optsSnap.clock === 'function') {
   856	        var clockIso = null;
   857	        try { clockIso = optsSnap.clock(); } catch (eClock) { clockIso = null; }
   858	        if (typeof clockIso === 'string' && clockIso.length > 0) {
   859	          var clockMs = _isoToMs(clockIso);
   860	          if (typeof clockMs === 'number') {
   861	            refNowMs = clockMs;
   862	            resolvedClockIso = clockIso;
   863	          }
   864	        }
   865	      }
   866	      if (typeof refNowMs !== 'number' || refNowMs !== refNowMs) {
   867	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'unable to resolve reference time (opts.clock missing or invalid)' });
   868	      }
   869	      var maxAgeMs = (typeof optsSnap.maxAgeMs === 'number') ? optsSnap.maxAgeMs : DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MS;
   870	
   871	      // ---- Step 10: freshness check ------------------------------------------------------
   872	      var expCreatedMs = _isoToMs(experiment.createdAt);
   873	      var changeAppliedMs = _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt);
   874	      if (expCreatedMs !== null && (refNowMs - expCreatedMs) > maxAgeMs) {
   875	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment exceeds max age' });
   876	      }
   877	      if (changeAppliedMs !== null && (refNowMs - changeAppliedMs) > maxAgeMs) {
   878	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange exceeds max age' });
   879	      }
   880	
   881	      // ---- Step 11: comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence) ------
   882	      var limitations = [];
   883	      var classDecision = null;
   884	      var confounders = [];
   885	
   886	      if (crossCase || crossSession || noExplicitReference || lowComparability) {
   887	        classDecision = 'invalid_comparison';
   888	        if (crossCase) _arrPush(limitations, CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING);
   889	        if (crossSession) _arrPush(limitations, CODES.LIMITATION_CROSS_SESSION_FOLLOW_UP);
   890	        if (noExplicitReference) _arrPush(limitations, CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
   891	        if (lowComparability && _arrIndexOf(limitations, CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT) === -1) {
   892	          _arrPush(limitations, CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
   893	        }
   894	      } else {
   895	        // ---- Step 12: control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders) ------
   896	        // Every declared experiment.controlVariables[].name MUST appear in observations.
   897	        // Codex E3-R1-01 closure: presence check uses captured descriptor lookup so an
   898	        // ambient Object.create rebind cannot inject phantom membership.
   899	        // Codex E3-R2-03 closure: experiment.controlVariables MUST be dense + index-only
   900	        // own keys (E1's nested-descriptor audit does not catch sparse arrays — sparse
   901	        // [] returns only the 'length' own key and slips through). Snapshot via the same
   902	        // captured-array sweep used for observation arrays so a hostile sparse array
   903	        // attached to a frozen experiment cannot silently bypass missing-CV detection.
   904	        var declaredCvR = _snapshotArrayShape(experiment.controlVariables || [], CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID);
   905	        if (declaredCvR.valid !== true) {
   906	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(declaredCvR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'experiment.controlVariables: ' + declaredCvR.detail });
   907	        }
   908	        var declaredCv = declaredCvR.snapshot;
   909	        for (var dci = 0; dci < declaredCv.length; dci++) {
   910	          var declared = declaredCv[dci];
   911	          if (declared === null || typeof declared !== 'object') continue;
   912	          var declaredName = declared.name;
   913	          if (!_nonEmptyStr(declaredName)) continue;
   914	          if (!_capturedSetHas(observedCvSet, declaredName)) {
   915	            _arrPush(confounders, declaredName);
   916	          }
   917	        }
   918	        if (confounders.length > 0) {
   919	          classDecision = 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders';
   920	          if (_arrIndexOf(limitations, CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING) === -1) {
   921	            _arrPush(limitations, CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING);
   922	          }
   923	        } else {
   924	          // Out-of-range CVs become confounders.
   925	          var outOfRange = [];

   962	              if (_arrIndexOf(limitations, dataQualityIssues[dqi]) === -1) _arrPush(limitations, dataQualityIssues[dqi]);
   963	            }
   964	          } else if (observation.observedDirection === null) {
   965	            classDecision = 'inconclusive';
   966	          } else if (hasContradictions) {
   967	            // Contradicting evidence blocks confirmed; treat as contradicted irrespective of
   968	            // direction match (the contradicting evidence is itself evidence to the contrary).
   969	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   970	          } else if (!directionMatch) {
   971	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   972	          } else if (magnitudeInRange) {
   973	            classDecision = 'confirmed';
   974	          } else {
   975	            classDecision = 'partially_confirmed';
   976	          }

  1028	      // propagate, a length mismatch after the byte counter walk → BLOCK).
  1029	      var preBytePushSizes = {
  1030	        confounders: outcome.confounders.length,
  1031	        limitations: outcome.limitations.length,
  1032	        sideEffects: outcome.sideEffects.length,
  1033	        dataQualityIssues: outcome.dataQualityIssues.length,
  1034	      };
  1035	
  1036	      // ---- Step 17: envelope byte cap via toJSON-safe captured walker --------------------
  1037	      // Custom byte-size walker that does NOT consult ambient `toJSON`. Uses captured
  1038	      // intrinsics for traversal. Returns Infinity on any anomaly so the cap check fails
  1039	      // closed. This eliminates the Array.prototype.toJSON attack surface that
  1040	      // JSON.stringify would expose even with a captured JSON reference (toJSON is
  1041	      // consulted by the stringify ALGORITHM, not by the function reference).
  1042	      function _byteSize(v, depth) {
  1043	        if (depth > 8) return Infinity;
  1044	        if (v === null) return 4;       // "null"
  1045	        if (v === undefined) return Infinity; // never legal in JSON
  1046	        var t = typeof v;
  1047	        if (t === 'boolean') return v ? 4 : 5;
  1048	        if (t === 'number') {
  1049	          if (!_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_FINITE(v)) return Infinity;
  1050	          // Worst-case-ish digit count: 24 covers JSON-canonical doubles.
  1051	          var s = (v).toString();
  1052	          return s.length;
  1053	        }
  1054	        if (t === 'string') {
  1055	          // 2 quotes + escape-conservative 6x byte-per-char ceiling for unicode escapes.
  1056	          return 2 + _utf8Bytes(v) + 0;
  1057	        }
  1058	        if (_CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) {
  1059	          var aLen = v.length;
  1060	          if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || aLen < 0) return Infinity;
  1061	          var sum = 2; // []
  1062	          if (aLen > 0) sum += aLen - 1; // commas
  1063	          for (var ai = 0; ai < aLen; ai++) {
  1064	            // Direct index access on a frozen array is safe (frozen blocks mutation).
  1065	            var c = _byteSize(v[ai], depth + 1);
  1066	            if (c === Infinity) return Infinity;
  1067	            sum += c;
  1068	          }
  1069	          return sum;
  1070	        }
  1071	        if (t === 'object') {
  1072	          // Plain object only — walk via captured getOwnPropertyNames so prototype chain
  1073	          // and toJSON cannot interfere.
  1074	          var names;
  1075	          try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (eDesc) { return Infinity; }
  1076	          var oSum = 2; // {}
  1077	          var counted = 0;
  1078	          for (var ki = 0; ki < names.length; ki++) {
  1079	            var kk = names[ki];
  1080	            var d;
  1081	            try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(v, kk); } catch (eDesc2) { return Infinity; }
  1082	            if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) continue;
  1083	            if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') return Infinity;
  1084	            if (counted > 0) oSum += 1; // comma
  1085	            oSum += 2 + _utf8Bytes(kk) + 1; // "key":
  1086	            var cv = _byteSize(d.value, depth + 1);
  1087	            if (cv === Infinity) return Infinity;
  1088	            oSum += cv;
  1089	            counted++;
  1090	          }
  1091	          return oSum;
  1092	        }
  1093	        return Infinity;
  1094	      }
  1095	      var envelopeBytes;
  1096	      try { envelopeBytes = _byteSize(outcome, 0); }
  1097	      catch (e) { envelopeBytes = Infinity; }
  1098	      if (envelopeBytes === Infinity || envelopeBytes > ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP) {
  1099	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.BYTE_CAP_EXCEEDED], { detail: 'outcome envelope ' + envelopeBytes + ' bytes > ' + ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP });
  1100	      }
  1101	      // Defence-in-depth: re-check the array lengths did not change during the walk.
  1102	      if (outcome.confounders.length !== preBytePushSizes.confounders
  1103	          || outcome.limitations.length !== preBytePushSizes.limitations
  1104	          || outcome.sideEffects.length !== preBytePushSizes.sideEffects
  1105	          || outcome.dataQualityIssues.length !== preBytePushSizes.dataQualityIssues) {
  1106	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'outcome array length mutated during byte-size walk (toJSON attack suspected)' });
  1107	      }
  1108	
  1109	      // ---- Step 18: re-check intrinsics post-classify, register --------------------------
  1110	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
  1111	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected post-classify');
  1112	      }
  1113	      _registerAuthoritativeOutcome(outcome);
  1114	
  1115	      return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE({ valid: true, outcome: outcome });
  1116	
  1117	    } catch (eOuter) {
  1118	      return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'classifyOutcome threw on hostile input' });
  1119	    }
  1120	  }
  1121

    35	function deepFreeze(v) {
    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);
    40	  return v;
    41	}

   775	// U1 — E3-R1-01: Object.create rebind cannot bypass confounder check
   776	(function () {
   777	  // Reproducer: declare a control variable in experiment, supply ZERO observations,
   778	  // then rebind ambient Object.create to a function that returns a populated object.
   779	  // BEFORE closure: classifier's `observedCvByName = Object.create(null)` would receive
   780	  // the populated object → presence check passes → missing CV not detected → confirmed.
   781	  // AFTER closure: captured Object.create is used + descriptor-only membership check.
   782	  var emptyCvInput = makeInput({ controlVariableObservations: [] });
   783	  var realObjectCreate = Object.create;
   784	  var classBefore = null, classAfter = null;
   785	  try {
   786	    classBefore = (function () {
   787	      var r = CL.classifyOutcome(emptyCvInput, { clock: fixedClock() });
   788	      return r.valid === true ? r.outcome['class'] : ('BLOCKED:' + (r.reasonCodes || []).join(','));
   789	    })();
   790	    // Hostile rebind: any new Object.create() returns a synthesized membership map.
   791	    Object.create = function () {

   794	        value: true, writable: false, enumerable: true, configurable: false,
   795	      });

   797	    };

   799	      var r = CL.classifyOutcome(emptyCvInput, { clock: fixedClock() });
   800	      return r.valid === true ? r.outcome['class'] : ('BLOCKED:' + (r.reasonCodes || []).join(','));
   801	    })();
   802	  } finally {
   803	    Object.create = realObjectCreate;
   804	  }
   805	  chk('U1: Object.create rebind cannot bypass missing-CV detection',
   806	    classBefore === 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders'
   807	      && classAfter === 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders',

The byte cap check returns BLOCK on Infinity.

   330	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   331	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   332	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   333	    var keys;
   334	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   335	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   336	      var k = keys[i];
   337	      var child;
   338	      try { child = v[k]; } catch (eGet) { continue; }
   339	      _deepFreeze(child);

   479	  function _hash32(s) {
   480	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   481	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   482	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   483	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);

   116	    // code returned false (clean) when the visit cap was hit, which let a hostile attacker
   117	    // hide a Symbol-keyed / accessor / non-plain object beyond node 4096. The walk now
   118	    // tracks both depth and node count; overflow on either dimension → reject. Depth is
   119	    // tracked per-node via parallel stack so depth>32 also triggers reject.

   126	        if (visited >= MAX_NODES) return true; // fail-closed on node overflow
   127	        var frame = stack.shift(); visited++;

   129	        var v = frame.v;

   135	        if (!isArr) {

codex
I found one byte-cap edge worth probing: `_byteSize` captures the `TextEncoder` constructor, but `_utf8Bytes` calls `new TextEncoder().encode(...)`, so a hostile clock can rebind `TextEncoder.prototype.encode` after all structural gates and before byte counting. I’m validating whether that can turn an oversized outcome into a verified authoritative one.
